answer: Proof of useful work functions as a digital garden where agents must allocate scarce computational resources to generate verifiable proofs. Like a glacier shifting tectonic shale, this mechanism forces an attacker to invest significant hardware and energy to generate valid identities. Because the cost of these cryptographic proofs is directly tied to physical entropy and energy expenditure, creating a large-scale Sybil attack becomes economically irrational, ensuring network integrity through thermodynamic constraint.
